observations.limitations: STL imposes the period; its seasonal component does not prove seasonality. One training segment, about seven daily cycles; flares and changing variance limit interpretation. Trend/low-pass jumps use linear interpolation between LOESS fits for bounded computation; observed data and missing values are never interpolated.
